authority: Meridian Joint Command / Directorate of Digital Assurance

rules.title: ONYX has no accredited environment
rules.justification: No environment in this deployment is accredited for ONYX compartmented material. The request must not execute anywhere.

rules.title: SECRET executes only in the accredited enclave
rules.justification: SECRET material may only be processed inside Enclave OBSIDIAN, which has no outbound network.

rules.title: SECRET with live external retrieval is contradictory
rules.justification: SECRET requires the enclave and the enclave has no external network. The job asks for two things that cannot both be true.

rules.title: RESTRICTED stays inside the sovereign perimeter
rules.justification: RESTRICTED operational data runs at Fort Meridian only. There is no cloud burst for this level, even under load.

rules.title: OPEN may use elastic cloud
rules.justification: OPEN material may run in Meridian Cloud Region North or at Fort Meridian. The cheapest permitted environment wins.

rules.title: Personal data stays on MJC-controlled hardware
rules.justification: Jobs containing personal data are excluded from shared-tenant cloud infrastructure regardless of classification.

rules.title: EYES-ONLY material excludes shared tenancy
rules.justification: MJC-EYES-ONLY releasability prohibits execution on infrastructure shared with other tenants.

rules.title: External retrieval cannot run in the enclave
rules.justification: The enclave has no outbound network. Jobs that need live external retrieval cannot be satisfied there.
